items.source: duration - the amount of time it took to find the main method
items.translation: duration - 查找主方法所花费的时间量。

items.source: mainMethod - the main method that was actually found

Callback interface used to present a warning when finding the main class takes too
long.
items.translation: 用于在查找主类耗时过长时发出警告的回调接口。

items.source: This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个函数式接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。
